title: Settings
planPaneMenus: Each pane's ⋮ menu offers its own switches too.

mcp.intro: The MCP sees only the roots listed here, and everything inside them. Private nodes stay hidden even inside a root. Agentic tasks inside a root can also be written; everything else is read-only.
mcp.none: No roots yet — the MCP sees nothing.
mcp.hidden: Private — the MCP cannot see it
mcp.missing: A node that no longer exists

endpoint.heading: Endpoint
endpoint.invalidPort: A port is a whole number from 1 to 65535.
endpoint.envOverride: ARLESH_MCP_PORT is set, so the endpoint uses port {{port}} instead of this setting until it is unset.

capacity.heading: Agent capacity
capacity.note: Agents set this over the MCP when they cannot take on more Agentic work, and clear it when there is room. While it is on, every Agentic task not yet done is blocked (“Agents at capacity”), so Start hides them and they cannot be started. You can set and clear it here, or clear it from the top bar.
capacity.showStatus: Show agent status in the top bar
